detail.longDescription:
If you or your company use Paycom’s HR and software, the Paycom app helps you manage everyday HR and payroll tasks in one place — like checking your schedule, requesting time off and reviewing your pay. It’s available in nearly 20 languages.
Some features may be enabled or disabled by your organization. For questions, contact your HR team.
All your data, quickly
Securely view your employee information anytime — pay, schedules, benefits, time-off balances and more. When you need data quickly, just ask IWant™, our command-driven AI engine, with a voice or text prompt and get it immediately. No navigation required.
Transparent payroll
Review, troubleshoot and approve your paycheck before payday. See all deductions and earnings and fix any issues early with our guided experience. Easily access pay stubs, Form W-2s and pay card information whenever.
Easy time tracking and scheduling
Clock in and out, submit time for approval, check time-off balances and request time off. View schedule information, swap shifts and pick up additional hours with ease.
Defeat the receipt
Upload receipts from your phone for reimbursement and track the status of submitted expenses. Plus, automatically track your business mileage.
Learn at your pace
Complete assigned training and learning paths in the app using your phone or tablet. No desktop required!
Front-line manager tools
If you’re a manager, you can act on hours worked, time-off requests and expenses; view org charts, team schedules and upcoming new hires; and process employee changes like promotions and transfers right from the app.
Automation built for admins
Real-time reporting and analytics allow for fast, usable compliance and executive strategy reporting for agile workforce management and business planning. Automatically respond to commonly asked employee questions with customizable templates and stored answers set by your organization. Empower your workforce with an experience that frees HR, engages employees and simplifies benefits and payroll for everyone involved.
Contact
We welcome, appreciate and listen to all feedback. Email us at MobileApp@Paycom.com
